name: Siwang Lüdian
source:
A group of people who didn't know each other found a dead body in a haunted house called "Death Inn". And when this group of people returned to the lobby again, ready to leave the place, the door was no longer there...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1081880/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一群互不相识的人在一座名叫“死亡客栈”的鬼屋里发现了一具尸体。当他们回到大厅、准备离开时，却发现门已经不见了……

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1081880/]Steam[/url]]
